name: flockcue-qwen35-2b-formal-continuation-20261112
objective: Does continued SFT with reviewed closings and verifications improve formal full-task success on A internal validation?

training.data: deduplicated first and reviewed repair releases; drop prompts above 30720 and re-reviewed invalid original endings; use 3 total exposures of each accepted closing-pack decision per additional epoch

validation.source: A internal_validation scenes 72ccacd0, 0293952c, cc14d231; 20 consecutive tasks per scene
validation.primary: formal passed tasks / 60 including terminal model HTTP errors as failures
secondary: per-task changes, by-scene totals and stop reason
validation.select: most formal passes; break ties in favor of the earlier checkpoint
validation.comparison: same task order, budgets, Harness, environment and scorer; historical paired base and first SFT denominators; dynamic simulator weather may differ
validation.diagnostics: teacher-forced losses on 12 original training probes and 9 reviewed closings; exclude these from selection
validation.exposure: internal validation was already used to diagnose first-pass failures; no B examples, B metrics or B model selection
validation.attribution: Joint change to training distribution and optimizer schedule; comparison of the two added checkpoints measures marginal continued training under the fixed schedule.
